messages:
aisha: Deploybot flagged EU canary p95 +120ms vs baseline, traffic at 20% — can we pause? :eyes:
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary rollout started: release=v3.5.1 slice=eu traffic=20% ts=3178524680 :rocket:
matt: seeing the spike on the dashboard, p95 jumped 90->220ms, errors ~0.8%
oliver: any config changes in this canary? kernel flags, kv cache?
aisha: yes, kv-cache hotpatch + quant path tweaks included in v3.5.1 canary. suspect kvcache interaction causing regen latency. recommend manual unwind and pin for dedicated customers.
leah: timeline? if we throttle will we see improvement quickly? last time drop helped within 30-60s.
aisha: plan: (1) pause autoscaling, (2) throttle canary to 5-10%, (3) pin dedicated customers to v3.5.0-dyn, (4) notify CS + watch metrics 10m. need ops approval to run.
matt: approve manual unwind. I'll execute and coordinate comms.
matt: /ops run ```sh
# reduce canary traffic to 10%
deployctl traffic adjust --slice eu --percent 10 --release v3.5.1
# pin dedicated customers to stable model variant
deployctl pin --scope dedicated --model v3.5.0-dyn
```
deploybot: [deploybot] Executing traffic adjust — started. rolling change id=roll-3178524680-01
deploybot: [deploybot] Pin operation queued for dedicated scope. job=pin-3178524680
kate-cs: I'll draft a short customer note: "We detected a transient latency regression in EU canary and temporarily throttled rollout; your Dedicated instances are pinned to the prior stable variant. We'll share updates." Want review?
oliver: monitoring kvcache miss rate + p95. setting a temporary alert to 150ms for 5m.
leah: ack, creating dashboard panel for kvcache misses and tail latency.
matt: traffic reach 10% — p95 dropped to 115ms after ~45s :thumbsup:
aisha: nice. keep at 10% for 30m to validate. if stable, we can resume to 20% with dedicated pinned until root cause fixed.
kate-cs: customer notes sent to enterprise eu group, incl. contact for urgent issues.
matt: release notes short update: "Canary throttled and Dedicated pinned due to latency regression; investigation ongoing." will add link to incident thread after postmortem.
aisha: thanks. opening a short investigation ticket and will follow up with RCA if kvcache interaction confirmed. :memo:
leah: leaving alert and dashboard in place, will post graphs in this thread in 10m.
matt: closing ops loop for now — monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
